Objects.name: ULSDVOBJ_TX_EmsG2_v1
Objects.description: G2 emitter telemetry (DPTF / DACS / ADS / ESTS frame, as ULS-QT1-R2): the current of every emitter from the VLED shunt, measured in its own slot of the frame, and the VLED trim codes the regulator loop chose. Refreshed once per frame.

variables.name: frames
variables.description: Frames emitted since power on; it steps each time the values below are refreshed

variables.name: Ialed
variables.description: ADS emitters 1..37 (SFH4248), current in their ADS slot

variables.name: Idled
variables.description: DACS emitters 1..4 (LUXEON IR), current in their DACS slot

variables.name: Va_lvl
variables.description: VLED trim code used for the ADS emitters, 0..63

variables.name: Vd_lvl
variables.description: VLED trim code used for the DACS emitters, 0..63
